description: Defines the HpackVarintDecoder class for decoding HPACK variable length unsigned integers used in HTTP/2 and QPACK. Includes methods for starting, resuming, and setting the decoder state, with internal handling of extension bytes and debug checks.

classes.name: HpackVarintDecoder
classes.description: A class for decoding HPACK variable length unsigned integers, supporting resumable decoding and handling extension bytes.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Initializes decoding with the first byte and prefix length, starting the process.

methods.name: StartExtended
methods.description: Begins decoding when multiple bytes are required, after detecting continuation bytes.

methods.name: Resume
methods.description: Resumes decoding after an earlier call indicated that more bytes are needed.

methods.name: set_value
methods.description: Sets the decoded value directly, used for optimization.

methods.name: DebugString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the decoder's current state for debugging.

methods.name: StartForTest
methods.description: Test version of Start, used for benchmarking.

methods.name: StartExtendedForTest
methods.description: Test version of StartExtended, used for benchmarking.

methods.name: ResumeForTest
methods.description: Test version of Resume, used for benchmarking.
